About

Since childhood, he dreamt of becoming several things. A cricketer, a footballer, an astronaut, and stand-up comedian. But life always takes turns, some of which are drastic.

In June 2022, he took off to start a new journey at a residential school all the way in Tamil Nadu. He stayed away from his hometown, from his parents, from all the things he loved for 6 years, to grow, to learn and to transform.

Education

He studied the ICSE curriculum at Greenlawns High School in Mumbai after which he pursued the CBSE curriculum at Chinmaya International Residential School, scoring a 95% in his 10th grade CBSE Board Examinations. He is now undergoing the IBDP curriculum where he is diving deeper into Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science and Economics.

Family

Behind the work and milestones, there is a clear personal foundation. In Shreiyaan's life, his family plays a direct and vital role.

His parents, Parin and Bijal Shah, have consistently encouraged his ambitions, providing the trust and direction needed to build new things.

Apart from them, Mokkshi Shah, his older sister, has always supported and encouraged him, making personal sacrifices so that he can follow his dream.

Projects
Project 01

AeroFlow

AeroFlow is a compact, fully enclosed, ducted wind turbine designed to provide continuous, clean electricity directly to homes and small businesses, bypassing grid dependency.

It addresses frequent power outages in developing regions that force reliance on polluting fossil-fuel generators, offering a gearless, highly efficient counter-rotating dual-rotor system with a custom magnet ring generator.

Its USP lies in its ultra-compact size (22.3 cm length, 30 cm radius) and gearless design that captures up to 80% of theoretical physics limits at low wind speeds, creating global impact by eliminating millions of fossil-fuel generators and bringing portable, decentralized clean power anywhere.
